listing.name: Night Slashers
listing.summary: Night Slashers Recomp is a native recompilation of Data East's 1994 arcade beat-'em-up for Windows, Linux, and Steam Deck. Features include a DECO32 runtime, enhanced arcade audio, SDL2 frontend, save states, rewind, controller support, customizable graphics, and modern quality-of-life improvements. Requires a user-supplied ROM.
